listing.name: Keyboard As Mouse - An Accessibility(?) Mod
listing.summary: This mod is built on a sort of library I'm referring to as True Input Faker, which it uses to generate fake mouse events (and possibly fake keyboard events in the future) by injecting itself between Starsector and the LWJGL game library it's built on.
listing.aiSummary: Allows controlling the in-game cursor using keyboard inputs for clicks, movement, scrolling, and dragging.

description: Injects itself between the game and its library to generate fake mouse events. It enables full keyboard control over actions normally requiring a mouse, including combat interactions, though it may have ergonomic quirks and input processing bugs with inventory items.
